comments.body: 2026-11-05, later the same day: the freesInFlight wait was not enough once - a full GUI run failed the unchanged aRemoteWebLinkIsReported OSC 8 + mouse-reporting case waiting for its link at 2x metrics; the case passed alone and a full repeat passed 21/21. ./release runs ./dev --contract, which runs these GUI tests, so this can stop a release. Log: /private/tmp/muster-slot2b-conversation-gui-all.log on the Mac mini.

comments.body: 2026-11-07 re-triage: raised. No commit between the pin and vt-1.0.0 explains this. #13960 and #14857 are nearby, and neither explains a dependence on the previous fixture. a_2vgzfDCvo changes surface teardown timing, which is what this card suspects, so settle this before the move and re-run it after.

comments.body: 2026-11-11: did not reproduce at vt-1.0.0: 65 of 65 SurfaceGUITests runs with the freesInFlight wait removed (whole suite x20, link matrix x15, with cmd-click and the free test x15, reversed order x15) at load 6-11. 386dec52 removes the wait so the suite would show the race again. Cause never named; the redesigned surface free (finish on the main queue) is a guess. Reopen on any link-case failure.

creator: Alexander Terp
description: Found 2026-11-05 building the captured-mouse link fix (4173bb80). Run back to back, SurfaceGUITests fixtures can fail to find a visible OSC 8 link even though a search finds its label; the same case run alone passes. Waiting for renderer.freesInFlight == 0 between fixtures makes the whole matrix pass in either order, and 4173bb80's fixtures do that wait. Cause unknown: it may be a lifecycle race in the product (a surface made while the previous one's teardown is in flight), not only in the test, so the wait is a workaround, not an explanation. Repro notes were in the worker's scratch files (/private/tmp/muster-slot2-link-debug.log) on the Mac mini.
title: A real-surface test that follows another can find no OSC 8 link where its label is
